title: selinum cerefolium
intro: Selinum cerefolium, commonly known as Chervil or Garden Chervil, is a perennial herb belonging to the parsley family (Apiaceae). This plant is valued for its culinary and medicinal properties, providing various health benefits such as improving digestion, reducing inflammation, and supporting immune function. The therapeutic actions of Selinum cerefolium include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful in treating respiratory issues, fever, and skin conditions. Bioactive constituents of the plant include volatile oils, flavonoids, and polyphenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
